svg.text: Activations O(1) at init. Feature learning O(1) per step. The rules drop out.
A1: activations at init stay O(1) in width
solve sigma from the spectral norm: init ~ 1/sqrt(fan-in) x sqrt(fan-out/fan-in)
A2: one gradient step changes activations by O(1)
LR ~ fan-out / fan-in (SGD). Adam: 1 / fan-in. Per-layer learning rates.
survives SwiGLU, RMSNorm. Breaks: learned RMSNorm gain, Lion, large decoupled weight decay.
Source: lecture muP derivation, original plate. Shell 2: assert invariance, derive the rule.
